messages.text: I’ll review the pinned benchmark and cache guard independently, focusing on matched physics settings, invalidation risks and the evidence needed to support performance claims. I’ll keep this review read-only and leave the active benchmark undisturbed.

The guard checks each logical volume’s material, region and cut association, which is stronger than checking counts alone. The supporting profile places most sampled cost in repeated material-cut table scans; the final comparison still needs to show that the shortcut preserves every recorded material step.

I’m applying the repository’s `nodd-review-validation` skill. I found one cache invalidation gap: Geant4 can update user energy-cut vectors without `IsModified()` becoming true. The coordinator is adding a sentinel for that path. The unchanged neutral-geantino setup remains a viable bounded experiment, pending full output equivalence checks.

MATPROF-PhysVal-01 reviewed **937422566fe0da577ec51862edf258631602026f**, read-only. No files changed or simulations run. Current dirty helper changes are outside this assessment.

- **P1 — Invalidation gap before broader use.** `native_timing.cpp:43–62,111–119` can skip required energy-cut updates: Geant4’s `SetEnergyCutVector` does not set the status tested by `IsModified()`, while `UpdateCoupleTable` handles those vectors separately. The proposed sentinel addresses this gap, but its implementation needs a new revision review. This does not invalidate an unchanged geantino fixture that never sets these vectors. [Geant4 v11.4.3 implementation](https://github.com/Geant4/geant4/blob/v11.4.3/source/processes/cuts/src/G4ProductionCutsTable.cc#L113), [status check](https://github.com/Geant4/geant4/blob/v11.4.3/source/processes/cuts/include/G4ProductionCutsTable.hh#L239).

- **P2 — Existing adverse controls are insufficient for a general safety claim.** `native_timing.cpp:67–94` tests three pointer replacements. Add in-place production-cut modification, null/stale couple, open geometry and extra region/root/world rejection. Check fallback execution as well as rejection. Couple membership/index consistency is not explicitly verified; retain the immutable-harness scope.

- **Required evidence — Output equivalence remains pending.** Compare baseline and opt-in output after both ROOT files close: generated probes, event/track counts, every scalar branch and every jagged material-step branch. Equal totals alone can conceal changed material boundaries or compensating differences. Bitwise branch equality is the appropriate initial criterion for identical inputs and an association-only shortcut.

The matched protocol is sound at the inspected sources: **100 events × 100 tracks**, seed 228, neutral geantinos, uniform η ∈ [−4,4], φ ∈ [0,360°], origin vertex, one thread and identical recorder options. `run.py:115–116` overrides the recorder function’s larger multiplicity default. The actual generator settings were checked in runtime source **530080cfe16c7513228bf60238b99d4b9938538a**.

The ODD selection is faithful for submodule **d70556f33b1c36abdf101a07ad8cf57eb56fbdf1**. `prepare_odd.py:15–31` retains beam pipe, pixels, PST, short/long strips and passive constituents, removing the explicit solenoid. Calorimeter, muon and field definitions enter through the excluded full-detector compact. Preserve and document the native world differences: ODD 12 m half sizes versus the supporting nODD compact’s 4 m, 4 m, 4.1 m. These and the different beam-pipe/material models limit direct material-total comparisons.

The ignored supporting evidence strongly supports repeated initialization as the current leading cause: **6192/6259** sampled main-thread stacks contain `UpdateCoupleTable`, versus **18** under event processing. Geant4 scans the volume tree separately for each region material; the supporting inventory implies approximately **767 million volume visits per update**. This explains a plausible scaling mechanism, without establishing the final timing ratio. [Geant4 scan implementation](https://github.com/Geant4/geant4/blob/v11.4.3/source/processes/cuts/src/G4ProductionCutsTable.cc#L126).

Report native timers as **inclusive/nested**; avoid summing them. Event markers include repeated run initialization, so their duration is not pure transport cost. Record the runtime Python source and native shim hashes alongside library/compact provenance. Exclude the earlier symbol-binding-altering trials.

Recommendation: retain the benchmark/profiling work and the narrowly scoped opt-in experiment, subject to the corrections and completed equivalence evidence above. These measurements characterize software behavior; they do not validate detector material realism, overlaps, reconstruction performance or DES-024/025 design acceptance.
